visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young Asian women with long dark hair stand in a brightly lit homeware store. The woman on the left wears a white cardigan over a cream top, and the woman on the right wears a red tank top and a denim skirt. They are holding two ceramic vases—one grey and one pink. They smile and look at each other before placing both vases into a black shopping cart in the foreground. (2) The scene cuts to another aisle with pillows and soft goods in the background. The two women are now holding large plush toys: a round turtle and a white goose. They interact playfully with the toys and each other, showing happy facial expressions, then drop them into the shopping cart. (3) The scene cuts again to an aisle with baskets and shelves. They are holding large bear-shaped plushies in vibrant blue and red colors. They pose and hug the plushies with cheerful smiles before putting them into the cart as well. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout.
